components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clear action in a local task group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #1768e5; color: #fff; font: 700 15px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #1254bc; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained supporting or reversible action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #dbe4ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1254bc; font: 700 15px/1 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #edf5ff; border-color: #aecfff; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A calm settings or research input with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #111827; font: 700 13px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field { height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #dbe4ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 400 16px/1.55 Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: #1768e5; outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 104, 229, 0.18); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact text-backed account, data, or runtime status.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: #d9e8ff; color: #1254bc; font: 700 13px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.25px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The user's current location in the desktop operational rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1768e5 0%, #1254bc 100%); box-shadow: 0 9px 20px rgba(23, 104, 229, 0.24); color: #fff; font: 700 15px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-active:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Standard Evidence Card
components.description: A bounded working surface for holdings, settings, research, or review evidence.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #dbe4ef; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 400 16px/1.55 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 700 18px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #6b7280; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Money Truth Panel
components.description: The signature high-contrast anchor for current account truth.
components.css: .ds-money-panel { display: grid; gap: 20px; min-height: 240px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 32px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #102a52 0%, #164a8a 100%); box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(15, 42, 82, 0.22); color: #f8fbff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-money-panel span { color: #d9e8ff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-money-panel strong { align-self: center; font-size: 44px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-money-panel small { align-self: end; color: #d9e8ff; } .ds-money-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Accordion
components.description: Progressive disclosure for strategy, provenance, and account-review depth.
components.html:
STRATEGY PERFORMANCE (TWR)

Cash-flow-neutral evidence and risk metrics.
components.css: .ds-accordion { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dbe4ef; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-accordion summary { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; } .ds-accordion[open] summary { background: #edf5ff; color: #113f8f; } .ds-accordion p { margin: 0; padding: 14px; color: #6b7280; } .ds-accordion summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1768e5; outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview:
Trading Max should feel like a calm control surface for financial truth: exact, trustworthy, and visibly under the user's control. It is an operational interface, not a spectacle. Dense account evidence remains scannable because hierarchy, spacing, and a restrained blue vocabulary make the important state obvious before interpretation begins.

The visual system pairs cool, quiet working surfaces with a small number of high-conviction moments. Signal Blue identifies current state and action; Ledger Navy grounds the most important money facts. The result is layered but restrained, with ambient depth reserved for genuine hierarchy. It must never resemble a speculative trading terminal or a flashy cryptocurrency dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Cool working surfaces with selective high-contrast anchors.
Operational states are explicit in text as well as color.
Bilingual composition remains equally intentional in Chinese and English.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks current state, focus, and action; it is not general decoration.

rules.name: The Ledger Grounding Rule
rules.body: Ledger Navy is reserved for the most important money truth or a compact metric band, never applied to every section.

rules.name: The Honest Status Rule
rules.body: Semantic color never carries status alone; pair it with a label, icon, sign, or explicit value.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: All numbers use tabular numerals so money, ratios, dates, and changing values remain aligned.

rules.name: The Heading Carries It Rule
rules.body: Do not add eyebrow or kicker text above a heading; hierarchy comes from the heading and its spatial context.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: Current account state must be findable before historical interpretation, research, or model commentary.

rules.name: The Ambient Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use depth only when an element is meaningfully above or more important than its neighbors.

rules.name: The One Elevation Signal Rule
rules.body: A routine card uses either its quiet boundary or a wide soft shadow; do not stack both treatments by default.

rules.name: The Radius Has Rank Rule
rules.body: Larger radii indicate larger structural scope; do not use the 32px money-anchor radius on routine cards.

dos: Do make current account state the strongest item in the first viewport.
Do use Signal Blue for current state, focus, and action.
Do reserve Ledger Navy for the primary money fact or compact metric band.
Do show unavailable, partial, retired, and stale states in explicit text.
Do preserve account-specific semantics and evidence provenance.
Do maintain keyboard, reduced-motion, mobile, Chinese, and English parity.
Do use existing Phosphor icons and Trading Max brand assets.
donts: Don't imitate speculative trading terminals, casino interfaces, or flashy cryptocurrency dashboards.
Don't use gradient text, decorative grids, fake market imagery, or motion without an operational purpose.
Don't turn every section into a shadowed card or nest cards as page structure.
Don't promote model commentary above deterministic account state.
Don't convert missing evidence into zero, invented content, or reassuring visual polish.
Don't use color as the only indicator of profit, loss, warning, or status.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings or uppercase prose as decoration.
